Used for cards the automated pipeline can't gate correctly: stems rendered as embedded IMAGES (no extractable text), or 陽明 booklets whose physical card order != 考選部 qNumber (breaks the monotonicity heuristic). Each entry was confirmed by reading the actual rendered card (題號 + stem + options + 答案). Pages are 0-based (builder adds +1). Highest-priority source in build-provenance-map.mjs.
